visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a medium close-up of a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white and grey textured top. She holds a silver mascara tube in her hands, smiling and gesturing toward the camera as the bold text 'BUY OR BYE' appears. The background is a softly lit, neutral-toned indoor space, creating a clean studio aesthetic. (2) The scene shifts to an extreme close-up of the woman's right eye, focusing on her lashes and sharp eyeliner wing. She blinks, allowing the viewer to see the current state of her makeup. The lighting is bright and directional, highlighting the fine details of the eye area. (3) The woman is shown holding the mascara wand close to the lens, revealing a unique comb-like structure rather than a traditional spiral brush. She points at the bristles while speaking, maintaining a friendly and engaging expression. The background remains consistent and out of focus. (4) The camera captures the woman applying the mascara to her upper lashes with steady, precise movements. In a later shot, she uses a white heated lash curler, pressing it against her lashes to enhance the curl. Her facial expression is focused, and the lighting remains bright and even. (5) The woman demonstrates a black eyeliner on the back of her hand, drawing a sharp, dark line. She then uses her finger to vigorously rub the mark, proving its resistance to smudging. The camera stays tightly framed on her hand and the product, with her face visible in the background. (6) The video concludes with a split-screen comparison labeled 'Before' and 'After,' showing the enhanced volume of her lashes. The woman returns to the medium close-up shot, holding the mascara tube, smiling, and making an 'OK' gesture with her hand to recommend the product.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: BUY OR BYE. [Subtitle]: 一支680的睫毛膏實測給你看. (2) [Subtitle]: 到底值不值得買. (3) [Subtitle]: 這支就是這次實測的新品. [Slogan]: KISSME LASH HYPE睫毛膏. (4) [Subtitle]: 然後KISSME的睫毛膏其實我已經用過非常多支了. 大家應該都知道我影片裡面常常出現他們家的產品. (5) [Subtitle]: 前陣子就蠻常在IG上面看到這一支新品. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後我覺得它很不一樣的一點是它的刷頭. (7) [Subtitle]: 以前都是做螺旋刷頭. [Variety]: 以前都是做螺旋刷頭. (8) [Subtitle]: 但現在變成梳子狀的捲翹立體刷頭. [Variety]: 梳子狀的捲翹立體刷頭. (9) [Subtitle]: 它就可以直接從你的眼睛根部撐起來. 所以你就會刷出濃密效果的睫毛. [Variety]: 濃密效果的睫毛. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後這個睫毛膏呢我個人覺得它是乾得比較快的類型. [Variety]: 尖端整理睫毛. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以你刷完第一次之後如果你覺得不夠濃密. 馬上再刷第二次. 它濃密的效果就會變得非常的明顯. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後因為我覺得它乾得比較快的原因. 它也跟其他濃密睫毛膏不太一樣. 就不會整坨沾在一起. (13) [Subtitle]: 防水效能就不用多提. 因為KISSME的這個持久功效絕對是一等一的. (14) [Subtitle]: 新品還添加了這個熱感捲翹定型成分. [Variety]: 熱感捲翹定型成分. (15) [Subtitle]: 所以呢如果你是像我一樣愛用加熱睫毛器的人. 去加熱睫毛的話它反而會讓它的捲翹度更持久. (16) [Subtitle]: 不會說一把它燙掉那個膏體就整個不見. (17) [Subtitle]: 除了睫毛膏之後今天眼線也是用他們家的這個超持久眼線液筆. [Slogan]: KISSME 超持久眼線液筆. (18) [Subtitle]: 然後這個我也介紹過非常多次了. 真的很持久. (19) [Subtitle]: 很絲滑很好畫. 然後呢它就是很防水然後怎麼摩擦它都不會暈. (20) [Subtitle]: 你看它根本搓不掉它就是完全不會暈. (21) [Subtitle]: 不知道你們看完以上的680睫毛膏實測覺得怎麼樣. [Variety]: Before. After. (22) [Subtitle]: 我個人是認為雖然有一點小貴. 就是以開架的價格來說. 但是它刷起來真的有我之前很愛用的專櫃濃密睫毛膏那一支的感覺. (23) [Subtitle]: 我相信如果你們常常在看我影片應該知道我在講哪一支. 就是我拿來刷下睫毛的那一支. (24) [Subtitle]: 這樣相較下來呢它的CP值還是蠻高的. 畢竟睫毛膏呢就是開封三個月你就要用完. (25) [Subtitle]: 而且最近有優惠開架又常常打折什麼的. 所以也不是真的680啦. (26) [Subtitle]: 如果大家最近想要入手新的睫毛膏的話真的可以試試看這一支.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is a young East Asian woman with long, dark, wavy hair. She wears a white and grey patterned knit top with cut-out details on the sleeves. Her makeup is polished, featuring defined eyeliner and colored contact lenses.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The background is a soft, out-of-focus indoor room with light-colored walls and a warm, glowing lamp visible on the right. The setting is clean and minimalist, typical of a professional beauty vlog.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a friendly, energetic tone with a moderate speech rate and high clarity. A background music track with an upbeat, lo-fi pop vibe and a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat starts simultaneously. The ambient noise floor is extremely low, typical of a studio-clean environment. (2) A subtle mechanical click occurs as the mascara tube is opened. The speaker's voice remains dominant, describing the product's price and branding. The BGM maintains a consistent volume and rhythm, featuring a simple synth melody that provides a light, commercial feel. (3) A distinct high-pitched beep and a mechanical click are heard as a heated lash curler is activated and pressed against the lashes. The narration shifts to the technical benefits of the new wand design, with the BGM continuing seamlessly in the background without any gaps or changes in intensity. (4) A short sequence of percussive friction sounds is audible as the speaker rubs the eyeliner drawn on her hand. These incidental noises are crisp and clear, signifying a close-up recording. The vocal arousal increases slightly as she demonstrates the product's waterproof and smudge-proof properties. (5) The video concludes with the speaker summarizing her final recommendation. The music swells slightly at the very end before a clean fade-out, coinciding with her positive closing remarks. The overall audio production is polished and exhibits a high signal-to-noise ratio.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Intro -> Product Features -> Application Demo -> Eyeliner Demo -> Before/After Comparison -> Recommendation.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The main purpose of the video is to provide a comprehensive review and live demonstration of the KISSME Lash Hype mascara and eyeliner. The creator evaluates the product's value proposition relative to its price, showcases the unique wand design, and proves its durability through friction tests, aiming to influence the audience's purchasing decision.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator identifies the products by name (KISSME), provides pricing information, and offers a strong verbal recommendation based on a direct trial.
